1	> ## Documentation Index
2	> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.polymarket.com/llms.txt
3	> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.
4	
5	# Python SDK
6	
7	> Get started with the unified Polymarket Python SDK.
8	
9	The `polymarket-client` package is the official Python SDK for building
10	Polymarket integrations.
11	
12	<CardGroup cols={2}>
13	  <Card title="GitHub" icon="github" href="https://github.com/Polymarket/py-sdk/">
14	    View the Python SDK source.
15	  </Card>
16	
17	  <Card title="PyPI Package" icon="python" href="https://pypi.org/project/polymarket-client/">
18	    Install `polymarket-client` from PyPI.
19	  </Card>
20	</CardGroup>
21	
22	See the [SDK Changelog](/changelog/sdks#python) for recent Python releases.
23	
24	## Quickstart
25	
26	<Steps>
27	  <Step title="Install the SDK">
28	    Install the SDK with your preferred package manager.
29	
30	    <CodeGroup>
31	      ```bash uv theme={null}
32	      uv add polymarket-client
33	      ```
34	
35	      ```bash pip theme={null}
36	      pip install polymarket-client
37	      ```
38	
39	      ```bash poetry theme={null}
40	      poetry add polymarket-client
41	      ```
42	    </CodeGroup>
43	  </Step>
44	
45	  <Step title="Create a Public Client">
46	    Create an `AsyncPublicClient` to access publicly available Polymarket data.
47	
48	    ```python theme={null}
49	    from polymarket import AsyncPublicClient
50	
51	
52	    async with AsyncPublicClient() as client:
53	        ...
54	    ```
55	  </Step>
56	
57	  <Step title="Fetch Active Markets">
58	    Fetch a page of active markets to discover trading opportunities.
59	
60	    ```python theme={null}
61	    import asyncio
62	
63	    from polymarket import AsyncPublicClient
64	
65	
66	    async def main() -> None:
67	        async with AsyncPublicClient() as client:
68	            pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
69	            first_page = await pages.first_page()
70	
71	            for market in first_page.items:
72	                # market: Market
73	                ...
74	
75	
76	    asyncio.run(main())
77	    ```
78	  </Step>
79	</Steps>
80	
81	## Async and Sync Interfaces
82	
83	Public clients access public data. [Secure clients](#secure-client) add trading
84	and account access. Both client types are available in async and sync forms.
85	
86	| Interface | Public data         | Trading and account data |
87	| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ |
88	| Async     | `AsyncPublicClient` | `AsyncSecureClient`      |
89	| Sync      | `PublicClient`      | `SecureClient`           |
90	
91	Async clients fit services, bots, and applications that already run an event
92	loop. Sync clients are convenient for scripts and notebooks.
93	
94	<CodeGroup>
95	  ```python Async theme={null}
96	  from polymarket import AsyncPublicClient
97	
98	
99	  async with AsyncPublicClient() as client:
100	      pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
101	      first_page = await pages.first_page()
102	  ```
103	
104	  ```python Sync theme={null}
105	  from polymarket import PublicClient
106	
107	
108	  with PublicClient() as client:
109	      pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
110	      first_page = pages.first_page()
111	  ```
112	</CodeGroup>
113	
114	<Note>
115	  Some features, including realtime subscriptions, are async-only because they
116	  rely on long-lived streams.
117	</Note>
118	
119	## Pagination
120	
121	SDK list methods use a consistent paginator interface. Iterate over the
122	paginator to retrieve every page, or fetch one page at a time when you need to
123	control pacing.
124	
125	<CodeGroup>
126	  ```python Async theme={null}
127	  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False, page_size=10)
128	
129	  async for page in pages:
130	      for market in page.items:
131	          # market: Market
132	          ...
133	  ```
134	
135	  ```python Sync theme={null}
136	  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False, page_size=10)
137	
138	  for page in pages:
139	      for market in page.items:
140	          # market: Market
141	          ...
142	  ```
143	</CodeGroup>
144	
145	When page boundaries do not matter, iterate over every item directly.
146	
147	<CodeGroup>
148	  ```python Async theme={null}
149	  async for market in pages.iter_items():
150	      # market: Market
151	      ...
152	  ```
153	
154	  ```python Sync theme={null}
155	  for market in pages.iter_items():
156	      # market: Market
157	      ...
158	  ```
159	</CodeGroup>
160	
161	`page.next_cursor` is an opaque SDK cursor. Store it as-is if you want to resume
162	a scan later, and omit it when starting from the first page.
163	
164	<CodeGroup>
165	  ```python Async theme={null}
166	  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False, page_size=10)
167	  page = await pages.first_page()
168	
169	  if page.next_cursor:
170	      second_page = await pages.from_cursor(page.next_cursor).first_page()
171	      # second_page.items: tuple[Market, ...]
172	  ```
173	
174	  ```python Sync theme={null}
175	  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False, page_size=10)
176	  page = pages.first_page()
177	
178	  if page.next_cursor:
179	      second_page = pages.from_cursor(page.next_cursor).first_page()
180	      # second_page.items: tuple[Market, ...]
181	  ```
182	</CodeGroup>
183	
184	## Types
185	
186	SDK methods return typed models, and their public types are exported from
187	`polymarket`.
188	
189	```python theme={null}
190	from polymarket import Event, Market, OrderBook, PriceHistoryPoint
191	```
192	
193	The SDK also uses distinct types for domain identifiers and EVM addresses.
194	Precision-sensitive values use `decimal.Decimal`, while dates and timestamps
195	use Python's `datetime` types.
196	
197	```python theme={null}
198	from polymarket import CtfConditionId, EvmAddress, MarketId, TokenId
199	```
200	
201	## Error Handling
202	
203	All SDK exceptions inherit from `PolymarketError`. Catch specific exceptions
204	when your application can respond to them, then catch the base exception as a
205	fallback.
206	
207	```python theme={null}
208	from polymarket import PolymarketError, RateLimitError, UserInputError
209	
210	pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
211	
212	try:
213	    page = await pages.first_page()
214	    # page.items: tuple[Market, ...]
215	except RateLimitError:
216	    # Retry later.
217	    ...
218	except UserInputError:
219	    # Fix the request parameters.
220	    ...
221	except PolymarketError:
222	    # Handle any other SDK error.
223	    raise
224	```
225	
226	## Secure Client
227	
228	Create an `AsyncSecureClient` or `SecureClient` when your integration needs to
229	trade or access account data. The Python SDK creates the signer from a local
230	private key.
231	
232	<CodeGroup>
233	  ```python Async theme={null}
234	  import os
235	
236	  from polymarket import AsyncSecureClient
237	
238	
239	  async with await AsyncSecureClient.create(
240	      private_key=os.environ["POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY"],
241	  ) as client:
242	      ...
243	  ```
244	
245	  ```python Sync theme={null}
246	  import os
247	
248	  from polymarket import SecureClient
249	
250	
251	  with SecureClient.create(
252	      private_key=os.environ["POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY"],
253	  ) as client:
254	      ...
255	  ```
256	</CodeGroup>
257	
258	Continue to [Wallets and Authentication](/trading/wallets-auth) to configure the
259	account wallet and gasless transactions.
260	
261	## Realtime Subscriptions
262	
263	The Python SDK can combine updates from multiple realtime feeds into a single
264	stream of events.
265	
266	<Note>
267	  Realtime subscriptions are available only through `AsyncPublicClient` and
268	  `AsyncSecureClient`. `PublicClient` and `SecureClient` do not implement
269	  `subscribe()`.
270	</Note>
271	
272	Call `subscribe()` with one or more subscription specs. Both `AsyncPublicClient`
273	and `AsyncSecureClient` support public streams, while `AsyncSecureClient` also
274	provides private streams for the connected account.
275	
276	<CodeGroup>
277	  ```python Public Client theme={null}
278	  from polymarket.streams import MarketSpec, SportsSpec
279	
280	  token_id = "<token_id>"
281	
282	  async with await client.subscribe(
283	      [MarketSpec(token_ids=[token_id]), SportsSpec()],
284	  ) as stream:
285	      async for event in stream:
286	          # event:
287	          #   MarketBookEvent
288	          #   | MarketPriceChangeEvent
289	          #   | MarketLastTradePriceEvent
290	          #   | MarketTickSizeChangeEvent

> ## Documentation Index
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.polymarket.com/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# Python SDK

> Get started with the unified Polymarket Python SDK.

The `polymarket-client` package is the official Python SDK for building
Polymarket integrations.

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="GitHub" icon="github" href="https://github.com/Polymarket/py-sdk/">
    View the Python SDK source.
  </Card>

  <Card title="PyPI Package" icon="python" href="https://pypi.org/project/polymarket-client/">
    Install `polymarket-client` from PyPI.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

See the [SDK Changelog](/changelog/sdks#python) for recent Python releases.

## Quickstart

<Steps>
  <Step title="Install the SDK">
    Install the SDK with your preferred package manager.

    <CodeGroup>
      ```bash uv theme={null}
      uv add polymarket-client
      ```

      ```bash pip theme={null}
      pip install polymarket-client
      ```

      ```bash poetry theme={null}
      poetry add polymarket-client
      ```
    </CodeGroup>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Create a Public Client">
    Create an `AsyncPublicClient` to access publicly available Polymarket data.

    ```python theme={null}
    from polymarket import AsyncPublicClient


    async with AsyncPublicClient() as client:
        ...
    ```
  </Step>

  <Step title="Fetch Active Markets">
    Fetch a page of active markets to discover trading opportunities.

    ```python theme={null}
    import asyncio

    from polymarket import AsyncPublicClient


    async def main() -> None:
        async with AsyncPublicClient() as client:
            pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
            first_page = await pages.first_page()

            for market in first_page.items:
                # market: Market
                ...


    asyncio.run(main())
    ```
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Async and Sync Interfaces

Public clients access public data. [Secure clients](#secure-client) add trading
and account access. Both client types are available in async and sync forms.

| Interface | Public data         | Trading and account data |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Async     | `AsyncPublicClient` | `AsyncSecureClient`      |
| Sync      | `PublicClient`      | `SecureClient`           |

Async clients fit services, bots, and applications that already run an event
loop. Sync clients are convenient for scripts and notebooks.

<CodeGroup>
  ```python Async theme={null}
  from polymarket import AsyncPublicClient


  async with AsyncPublicClient() as client:
      pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
      first_page = await pages.first_page()
  ```

  ```python Sync theme={null}
  from polymarket import PublicClient


  with PublicClient() as client:
      pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
      first_page = pages.first_page()
  ```
</CodeGroup>

<Note>
  Some features, including realtime subscriptions, are async-only because they
  rely on long-lived streams.
</Note>

## Pagination

SDK list methods use a consistent paginator interface. Iterate over the
paginator to retrieve every page, or fetch one page at a time when you need to
control pacing.

<CodeGroup>
  ```python Async theme={null}
  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False, page_size=10)

  async for page in pages:
      for market in page.items:
          # market: Market
          ...
  ```

  ```python Sync theme={null}
  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False, page_size=10)

  for page in pages:
      for market in page.items:
          # market: Market
          ...
  ```
</CodeGroup>

When page boundaries do not matter, iterate over every item directly.

<CodeGroup>
  ```python Async theme={null}
  async for market in pages.iter_items():
      # market: Market
      ...
  ```

  ```python Sync theme={null}
  for market in pages.iter_items():
      # market: Market
      ...
  ```
</CodeGroup>

`page.next_cursor` is an opaque SDK cursor. Store it as-is if you want to resume
a scan later, and omit it when starting from the first page.

<CodeGroup>
  ```python Async theme={null}
  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False, page_size=10)
  page = await pages.first_page()

  if page.next_cursor:
      second_page = await pages.from_cursor(page.next_cursor).first_page()
      # second_page.items: tuple[Market, ...]
  ```

  ```python Sync theme={null}
  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False, page_size=10)
  page = pages.first_page()

  if page.next_cursor:
      second_page = pages.from_cursor(page.next_cursor).first_page()
      # second_page.items: tuple[Market, ...]
  ```
</CodeGroup>

## Types

SDK methods return typed models, and their public types are exported from
`polymarket`.

```python theme={null}
from polymarket import Event, Market, OrderBook, PriceHistoryPoint
```

The SDK also uses distinct types for domain identifiers and EVM addresses.
Precision-sensitive values use `decimal.Decimal`, while dates and timestamps
use Python's `datetime` types.

```python theme={null}
from polymarket import CtfConditionId, EvmAddress, MarketId, TokenId
```

## Error Handling

All SDK exceptions inherit from `PolymarketError`. Catch specific exceptions
when your application can respond to them, then catch the base exception as a
fallback.

```python theme={null}
from polymarket import PolymarketError, RateLimitError, UserInputError

pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)

try:
    page = await pages.first_page()
    # page.items: tuple[Market, ...]
except RateLimitError:
    # Retry later.
    ...
except UserInputError:
    # Fix the request parameters.
    ...
except PolymarketError:
    # Handle any other SDK error.
    raise
```

## Secure Client

Create an `AsyncSecureClient` or `SecureClient` when your integration needs to
trade or access account data. The Python SDK creates the signer from a local
private key.

<CodeGroup>
  ```python Async theme={null}
  import os

  from polymarket import AsyncSecureClient


  async with await AsyncSecureClient.create(
      private_key=os.environ["POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY"],
  ) as client:
      ...
  ```

  ```python Sync theme={null}
  import os

  from polymarket import SecureClient


  with SecureClient.create(
      private_key=os.environ["POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY"],
  ) as client:
      ...
  ```
</CodeGroup>

Continue to [Wallets and Authentication](/trading/wallets-auth) to configure the
account wallet and gasless transactions.

## Realtime Subscriptions

The Python SDK can combine updates from multiple realtime feeds into a single
stream of events.

<Note>
  Realtime subscriptions are available only through `AsyncPublicClient` and
  `AsyncSecureClient`. `PublicClient` and `SecureClient` do not implement
  `subscribe()`.
</Note>

Call `subscribe()` with one or more subscription specs. Both `AsyncPublicClient`
and `AsyncSecureClient` support public streams, while `AsyncSecureClient` also
provides private streams for the connected account.

<CodeGroup>
  ```python Public Client theme={null}
  from polymarket.streams import MarketSpec, SportsSpec

  token_id = "<token_id>"

  async with await client.subscribe(
      [MarketSpec(token_ids=[token_id]), SportsSpec()],
  ) as stream:
      async for event in stream:
          # event:
          #   MarketBookEvent
          #   | MarketPriceChangeEvent
          #   | MarketLastTradePriceEvent
          #   | MarketTickSizeChangeEvent
          #   | MarketBestBidAskEvent
          #   | NewMarketEvent
          #   | MarketResolvedEvent
          #   | SportsEvent

          if should_close:
              break
  ```

  ```python Secure Client theme={null}
  from polymarket.streams import MarketSpec, UserSpec

  token_id = "<token_id>"

  async with await client.subscribe(
      [MarketSpec(token_ids=[token_id]), UserSpec()],
  ) as stream:
      async for event in stream:
          # event:
          #   MarketBookEvent
          #   | MarketPriceChangeEvent
          #   | MarketLastTradePriceEvent
          #   | MarketTickSizeChangeEvent
          #   | MarketBestBidAskEvent
          #   | NewMarketEvent
          #   | MarketResolvedEvent
          #   | UserEvent

          if should_close:
              break
  ```
</CodeGroup>

Narrow `event.topic` before handling a specific event shape. The examples show
a few streams; see [Real-Time Data](/market-data/realtime-data),
[Real-Time Order Updates](/trading/realtime-order-updates), and
[Perps Realtime Updates](/perps/realtime-updates) for feed-specific options.

## DataFrames and Jupyter

Convert pages and paginators directly to a
[pandas DataFrame](https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/stable/reference/api/pandas.DataFrame.html),
[Polars DataFrame](https://docs.pola.rs/py-polars/html/reference/dataframe/), or
[Apache Arrow Table](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/python/generated/pyarrow.Table.html).
Install the `pandas`, `polars`, or `arrow` package extra for the format you use;
the `quant` extra installs all three.

<CodeGroup>
  ```python Pandas theme={null}
  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
  df = await pages.to_pandas(limit=100)
  ```

  ```python Polars theme={null}
  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
  df = await pages.to_polars(limit=100)
  ```

  ```python Arrow theme={null}
  pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
  table = await pages.to_arrow(limit=100)
  ```
</CodeGroup>

Paginator conversions require an explicit limit. Pass `limit=None` to retrieve
every item.

Common SDK objects also render as compact cards in
[Jupyter](https://docs.jupyter.org/en/stable/) notebooks. Return an object as
the last expression in a cell to display it.

```python theme={null}
pages = client.list_markets(closed=False)
page = await pages.first_page()
page.items[0]
```

## Next Steps

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Read Market Data" icon="chart-line" href="/market-data/overview">
    Discover markets and work with prices, order books, and historical data.
  </Card>

  <Card title="Subscribe to Real-Time Updates" icon="radio" href="/market-data/realtime-data">
    Stream market and account updates as they happen.
  </Card>

  <Card title="Place Your First Order" icon="rocket" href="/trading/quickstart">
    Set up an account and complete your first authenticated trade.
  </Card>

  <Card title="Use Session Keys" icon="key" href="/trading/session-keys">
    Grant scoped, time-limited Deposit Wallet access to a separate signer.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

476:Some markets charge trading fees. The fee schedule determines how fees vary
481:    Read the market's fee configuration:
484:    const feesEnabled = market.trading.feesEnabled;
485:    const feeSchedule = market.trading.feeSchedule;
487:    // feesEnabled: boolean | null
488:    // feeSchedule: {

    Connect to the market WebSocket:

    ```text theme={null}
    wss://ws-subscriptions-clob.polymarket.com/ws/market
    ```

    <Note>
      The market WebSocket uses an application-level heartbeat. Send the text frame
      `PING` every 10 seconds; the server replies with `PONG`.
    </Note>

    Once connected, send a `market` subscription frame with one or more token
    IDs:

    ```json theme={null}
    {
      "assets_ids": ["<token_id>"],
      "type": "market"
    }
    ```

    try:
        async with websockets.connect("wss://ws-live-data.polymarket.com", open_timeout=10) as ws:
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"action":"subscribe","subscriptions":[{"topic":"crypto_prices_chainlink","type":"*","filters":"{\"symbol\":\"btc/usd\"}"}]}))
            t=time.time()
            while time.time()-t<8:
                m=await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(),8); print("RTDS:",str(m)[:300])

async def bolt():
    try:
        async with websockets.connect("wss://ws-live-v2.polymarket.com/ws", open_timeout=10) as ws:
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"op":"subscribe","rid":"s1","subscriptions":[{"channel":"price.crypto","filter":{"symbol":"btcusd"}}]}))
            t=time.time()
            while time.time()-t<6:
                m=await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(),6); print("BOLT:",str(m)[:300])
    except Exception as e: print("BOLT err:",repr(e))
async def binance():
    try:
        async with websockets.connect("wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/btcusdt@trade", open_timeout=10) as ws:
            m=await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(),6); print("BINANCE:",str(m)[:200])
    except Exception as e: print("BINANCE err:",repr(e))
async def main(): await asyncio.gather(rtds(),bolt(),binance())
asyncio.run(main())
EOF

    Remove the previous CLOB, relayer, and builder-signing packages. Then install the

    <CodeGroup>
      ```bash uv theme={null}

        | `matched` | The order matched immediately with resting liquidity.    |
        | `delayed` | The order is marketable but subject to a matching delay. |

        A rejected order returns `ok: false` with a code and message.
      </Step>
    </Steps>
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Python">
    Given an `AsyncSecureClient`, place the limit order and check
    its response. The synchronous `SecureClient` provides the same method.

    <Steps>
      <Step title="Place the Order">
        First, call `place_limit_order()` with the price and number of shares. The
        price must follow the market's minimum price increment, and the size must
        meet its minimum order size. Omit `expiration` for a GTC order or provide a
        Unix timestamp in seconds for a GTD order.

        <CodeGroup>
          ```python GTC theme={null}
          response = await client.place_limit_order(
              token_id=yes_token_id,
              side="BUY",
              price="0.52",
              size="10",
          )

          # response: OrderResponse
          ```

          ```python GTD theme={null}
          import time

          expiration = int(time.time()) + 60 + 60 * 60
          response = await client.place_limit_order(
              token_id=yes_token_id,
              side="BUY",
              price="0.52",
              size="10",
              expiration=expiration,
          )

          # response: OrderResponse
          ```
        </CodeGroup>

        Both examples buy `10` shares at a price of `0.52` USD per share. The GTD
        order has an effective lifetime of one hour.
      </Step>

        Then, check `response.ok` to determine whether the CLOB accepted the order:

        if response.ok:

    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Python">
    Given an `AsyncSecureClient`, set `post_only` when placing
    the limit order. The synchronous `SecureClient` provides the same method.

    ```python theme={null}
    response = await client.place_limit_order(
        token_id=yes_token_id,
        side="BUY",
        price="0.52",
        size="10",
        post_only=True,
    )

    # response: OrderResponse
    </Steps>
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Python">
    Given an `AsyncSecureClient`, estimate the price and place
    the market order. The synchronous `SecureClient` provides the same methods.

    <Steps>
      <Step title="Estimate the Price">
        First, call `estimate_market_price()` to discover the price level the order
        would reach at the current order-book depth. For a BUY, `amount` is the USD
        notional to spend. For a SELL, `shares` is the number of shares to sell,
        rather than their USD value.

        <CodeGroup>
          ```python Buy theme={null}
          estimated_buy_price = await client.estimate_market_price(
              token_id=yes_token_id,
              side="BUY",
              amount="10",
              order_type="FAK",
          )

          # estimated_buy_price: Decimal
          ```

          ```python Sell theme={null}
          estimated_sell_price = await client.estimate_market_price(
              token_id=yes_token_id,
              side="SELL",
              shares="10",
              order_type="FAK",
          )

          # estimated_sell_price: Decimal
          ```
        </CodeGroup>

        In these examples, `amount="10"` means spending \$10, while `shares="10"`
        means selling 10 shares.

        The estimate is a snapshot of the current order book. The available price
        can change before you submit the order.
      </Step>

      <Step title="Place the Order">
        Then, if the estimated price is acceptable, pass it as the maximum price
        for a BUY or the minimum price for a SELL, and place the market order:

        <CodeGroup>
          ```python Buy theme={null}
          response = await client.place_market_order(
              token_id=yes_token_id,
              side="BUY",
              amount="10",
              max_price=estimated_buy_price,
              order_type="FAK",
          )

          # response: OrderResponse
          ```

          ```python Sell theme={null}
          response = await client.place_market_order(
              token_id=yes_token_id,
              side="SELL",
              shares="10",
              min_price=estimated_sell_price,
              order_type="FAK",
          )

          # response: OrderResponse
          ```
        </CodeGroup>

        `max_price` prevents a BUY from crossing a higher price, while `min_price`
        prevents a SELL from crossing a lower one. If the book moves before
        submission, the order may fill only partially or not at all.
      </Step>

      <Step title="Check the Response">
        Then, check `response.ok` to determine whether the CLOB accepted the
        order:

        ```python theme={null}
        if response.ok:
            print(response.order_id, response.status)
            print(response.trade_ids, response.transactions_hashes)
        else:
            print(response.code, response.message)
        ```

        An accepted response includes the order ID and one of these statuses. If
        the order fills fully or partially, `trade_ids` identifies the resulting

        hashes:

        | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
        | `matched` | The order matched immediately with resting liquidity.                         |
        | `delayed` | The market imposes a matching delay; matching begins after the delay elapses. |

import os
import sys

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from position import (DOWN, UP, MinProfit, Position, ceil_to_tick, fee_usd,  # noqa: E402
                      floor_to_tick, taker_buy_net_shares, walk_book)

CRYPTO = 0.07


# ---------- комиссии: сверка с таблицей docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees (100 шейров, Crypto) ----------
@pytest.mark.parametrize("price,expected", [
    (0.01, 0.07), (0.05, 0.33), (0.10, 0.63), (0.20, 1.12), (0.30, 1.47),
    (0.45, 1.73), (0.50, 1.75), (0.55, 1.73), (0.70, 1.47), (0.90, 0.63), (0.99, 0.07),
])
def test_fee_table_crypto(price, expected):
    assert round(fee_usd(100, price, CRYPTO), 2) == pytest.approx(expected, abs=0.006)


def test_fee_symmetric():
    assert fee_usd(37, 0.3, CRYPTO) == fee_usd(37, 0.7, CRYPTO)


def test_fee_zero_for_maker_rate_and_zero_shares():
    assert fee_usd(100, 0.5, 0.0) == 0.0
    assert fee_usd(0, 0.5, CRYPTO) == 0.0


def test_fee_rounded_to_5_decimals():
    f = fee_usd(1, 0.123, CRYPTO)
    assert f == round(f, 5)
    assert fee_usd(0.0001, 0.01, CRYPTO) == 0.0  # меньше 0.00001 -> 0


def test_taker_buy_fee_in_shares():
    net, cost, f = taker_buy_net_shares(100, 0.5, CRYPTO)
    assert f == pytest.approx(1.75)
    assert cost == pytest.approx(50.0)
    assert net == pytest.approx(100 - 1.75 / 0.5)  # 96.5 шейров


def test_taker_buy_fee_in_usdc_mode():
    net, cost, f = taker_buy_net_shares(100, 0.5, CRYPTO, fee_in_shares=False)
    assert net == 100 and cost == pytest.approx(51.75)


# ---------- позиция ----------
def test_pnl_both_sides_maker():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    p.buy_maker(DOWN, 10, 0.50)
    assert p.spent == pytest.approx(9.5)
    assert p.pnl_if_up == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert p.pnl_if_down == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert p.worst_case == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert p.unhedged_risk() == 0
    assert p.is_hedged(MinProfit(pct=0.03))       # 0.5 >= 0.285
    assert not p.is_hedged(MinProfit(usd=1.0))


def test_one_leg_is_unhedged():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    assert p.pnl_if_up == pytest.approx(5.5)
    assert p.pnl_if_down == pytest.approx(-4.5)
    assert p.worst_case == pytest.approx(-4.5)
    assert p.unhedged_risk() == pytest.approx(4.5)
    assert p.deficit(DOWN) == pytest.approx(10)
    assert p.deficit(UP) == 0
    assert p.leading_side() == UP


def test_empty_position_not_hedged():
    assert not Position().is_hedged(MinProfit(usd=0))


def test_taker_fill_uses_real_net_shares():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    p.buy_taker(DOWN, 10, 0.50, CRYPTO)   # fee 0.175$ -> 0.35 шейра
    assert p.qty[DOWN] == pytest.approx(9.65)
    assert p.fees == pytest.approx(0.175)
    assert p.spent == pytest.approx(9.5)
    assert p.pnl_if_down == pytest.approx(0.15)
    assert p.worst_case == pytest.approx(0.15)


def test_sell_taker():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    p.sell_taker(UP, 10, 0.40, CRYPTO)   # выручка 4.0 - 0.168
    assert p.qty[UP] == pytest.approx(0)
    fee = fee_usd(10, 0.40, CRYPTO)
    assert p.spent == pytest.approx(4.5 - 4.0 + fee)
    assert p.worst_case == pytest.approx(-(0.5 + fee))


def test_avg_price():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.35)
    assert p.avg_price(UP) == pytest.approx(0.40)
    assert p.avg_price(DOWN) is None


# ---------- максимальная цена добора ----------
def test_max_hedge_price_pct():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    mp = MinProfit(pct=0.03)
    price = p.max_hedge_price_maker(DOWN, 10, mp)
    # 10 - (4.5 + 10p) >= 0.03 (4.5 + 10p) -> p <= (10/1.03 - 4.5)/10 = 0.5208...
    assert price == pytest.approx(0.52)
    after = p.what_if_maker_buy(DOWN, 10, price)
    assert after.is_hedged(mp)
    # на тик выше - уже не захеджировано
    worse = p.what_if_maker_buy(DOWN, 10, price + 0.01)
    assert not worse.is_hedged(mp)


def test_max_hedge_price_usd():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 20, 0.40)   # spent 8
    mp = MinProfit(usd=1.0)
    price = p.max_hedge_price_maker(DOWN, 20, mp)
    # 20 - 8 - 20p >= 1 -> p <= 0.55
    assert price == pytest.approx(0.55)
    assert p.what_if_maker_buy(DOWN, 20, price).worst_case == pytest.approx(1.0)


def test_max_hedge_price_partial_hedge_limited_by_other_side():
    # докупаем меньше дефицита: ограничивает pnl по отстающей стороне
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    price = p.max_hedge_price_maker(DOWN, 5, MinProfit(pct=0.03))
    assert price is None  # 5 шейров Down никогда не покроют 4.5$+ трат


def test_max_hedge_price_none_when_impossible():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.95)
    assert p.max_hedge_price_maker(DOWN, 10, MinProfit(pct=0.10)) is None


def test_max_hedge_price_rounds_down_to_tick():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 7, 0.43)
    mp = MinProfit(pct=0.03)
    price = p.max_hedge_price_maker(DOWN, 7, mp, tick=0.01)
    assert price == floor_to_tick(price, 0.01)
    assert p.what_if_maker_buy(DOWN, 7, price).is_hedged(mp)
    assert not p.what_if_maker_buy(DOWN, 7, round(price + 0.01, 2)).is_hedged(mp)


def test_max_hedge_price_with_averaged_leg():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.35)   # 20 шейров за 8$
    mp = MinProfit(pct=0.03)
    price = p.max_hedge_price_maker(DOWN, 20, mp)
    assert p.what_if_maker_buy(DOWN, 20, price).is_hedged(mp)
    assert price == pytest.approx(0.57)  # (20/1.03 - 8)/20 = 0.5708


# ---------- утилиты ----------
def test_tick_rounding():
    assert floor_to_tick(0.5299999, 0.01) == 0.52
    assert floor_to_tick(0.53, 0.01) == 0.53
    assert ceil_to_tick(0.5201, 0.01) == 0.53
    assert floor_to_tick(0.9876, 0.001) == 0.987


def test_minprofit_parse():
    assert MinProfit.parse("3%").pct == pytest.approx(0.03)
    assert MinProfit.parse("0.5").usd == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert MinProfit.parse("3%").required(10) == pytest.approx(0.3)


def test_walk_book_buy_levels_and_limit():
    asks = [(0.50, 5), (0.51, 5), (0.53, 100)]
    assert walk_book(asks, 8) == [(0.50, 5), (0.51, 3)]
    assert walk_book(asks, 20, limit_price=0.51) == [(0.50, 5), (0.51, 5)]  # FAK: частично

import os
import sys

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

    (0.01, 0.07), (0.05, 0.33), (0.10, 0.63), (0.20, 1.12), (0.30, 1.47),
    (0.45, 1.73), (0.50, 1.75), (0.55, 1.73), (0.70, 1.47), (0.90, 0.63), (0.99, 0.07),
])

    assert round(fee_usd(100, price, CRYPTO), 2) == pytest.approx(expected, abs=0.006)


def test_fee_symmetric():
    assert fee_usd(37, 0.3, CRYPTO) == fee_usd(37, 0.7, CRYPTO)


def test_fee_zero_for_maker_rate_and_zero_shares():
    assert fee_usd(100, 0.5, 0.0) == 0.0
    assert fee_usd(0, 0.5, CRYPTO) == 0.0


def test_fee_rounded_to_5_decimals():
    f = fee_usd(1, 0.123, CRYPTO)
    assert f == round(f, 5)
    assert fee_usd(0.0001, 0.01, CRYPTO) == 0.0  # меньше 0.00001 -> 0


def test_taker_buy_fee_in_shares():
    net, cost, f = taker_buy_net_shares(100, 0.5, CRYPTO)
    assert f == pytest.approx(1.75)
    assert cost == pytest.approx(50.0)
    assert net == pytest.approx(100 - 1.75 / 0.5)  # 96.5 шейров


def test_taker_buy_fee_in_usdc_mode():
    net, cost, f = taker_buy_net_shares(100, 0.5, CRYPTO, fee_in_shares=False)
    assert net == 100 and cost == pytest.approx(51.75)


# ---------- позиция ----------
def test_pnl_both_sides_maker():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    p.buy_maker(DOWN, 10, 0.50)
    assert p.spent == pytest.approx(9.5)
    assert p.pnl_if_up == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert p.pnl_if_down == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert p.worst_case == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert p.unhedged_risk() == 0
    assert p.is_hedged(MinProfit(pct=0.03))       # 0.5 >= 0.285
    assert not p.is_hedged(MinProfit(usd=1.0))


def test_one_leg_is_unhedged():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    assert p.pnl_if_up == pytest.approx(5.5)
    assert p.pnl_if_down == pytest.approx(-4.5)
    assert p.worst_case == pytest.approx(-4.5)
    assert p.unhedged_risk() == pytest.approx(4.5)
    assert p.deficit(DOWN) == pytest.approx(10)
    assert p.deficit(UP) == 0
    assert p.leading_side() == UP


def test_empty_position_not_hedged():
    assert not Position().is_hedged(MinProfit(usd=0))


def test_taker_fill_uses_real_net_shares():

    p.buy_taker(DOWN, 10, 0.50, CRYPTO)   # fee 0.175$ -> 0.35 шейра

    assert p.fees == pytest.approx(0.175)
    assert p.spent == pytest.approx(9.5)

    assert p.worst_case == pytest.approx(0.15)


def test_sell_taker():

    assert p.worst_case == pytest.approx(-(0.5 + fee))


def test_avg_price():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.35)
    assert p.avg_price(UP) == pytest.approx(0.40)
    assert p.avg_price(DOWN) is None


# ---------- максимальная цена добора ----------
def test_max_hedge_price_pct():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)
    mp = MinProfit(pct=0.03)
    price = p.max_hedge_price_maker(DOWN, 10, mp)
    # 10 - (4.5 + 10p) >= 0.03 (4.5 + 10p) -> p <= (10/1.03 - 4.5)/10 = 0.5208...
    assert price == pytest.approx(0.52)

    assert not p.what_if_maker_buy(DOWN, 7, round(price + 0.01, 2)).is_hedged(mp)


def test_max_hedge_price_with_averaged_leg():
    p = Position()
    p.buy_maker(UP, 10, 0.45)

    assert price == pytest.approx(0.57)  # (20/1.03 - 8)/20 = 0.5708


# ---------- утилиты ----------
def test_tick_rounding():
    assert floor_to_tick(0.5299999, 0.01) == 0.52
    assert floor_to_tick(0.53, 0.01) == 0.53
    assert ceil_to_tick(0.5201, 0.01) == 0.53
    assert floor_to_tick(0.9876, 0.001) == 0.987


def test_minprofit_parse():
    assert MinProfit.parse("3%").pct == pytest.approx(0.03)
    assert MinProfit.parse("0.5").usd == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert MinProfit.parse("3%").required(10) == pytest.approx(0.3)


def test_walk_book_buy_levels_and_limit():
    asks = [(0.50, 5), (0.51, 5), (0.53, 100)]
    assert walk_book(asks, 8) == [(0.50, 5), (0.51, 3)]
    assert walk_book(asks, 20, limit_price=0.51) == [(0.50, 5), (0.51, 5)]  # FAK: частично


def test_walk_book_sell():

"""Все параметры бота. Читаются из .env (или переменных окружения)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv

from position import MinProfit

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load_dotenv(BASE_DIR / ".env")


def _s(name: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    return os.getenv(name, default).strip()


def _f(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    v = _s(name)
    return float(v) if v else default


def _i(name: str, default: int) -> int:
    v = _s(name)
    return int(v) if v else default


def _b(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    v = _s(name).lower()
    if not v:
        return default
    return v in ("1", "true", "yes", "on", "да")


@dataclass
class Config:
    # --- режим ---
    live_trading: bool = field(default_factory=lambda: _b("LIVE_TRADING", False))

    # --- секреты (только из .env, в логи не пишутся) ---
    private_key: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _s("POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY"), repr=False)
    wallet_address: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _s("POLYMARKET_WALLET_ADDRESS"))
    tg_token: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _s("TG_BOT_TOKEN"), repr=False)
    tg_chat_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _s("TG_CHAT_ID"))

    # --- стратегия ---
    start_bid: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("START_BID", 0.45))
    quote_size: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("QUOTE_SIZE", 10))          # шейров в первой котировке
    add_step: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("ADD_STEP", 0.05))            # усреднение: ниже средней на столько
    min_profit: MinProfit = field(default_factory=lambda: MinProfit.parse(_s("MIN_PROFIT", "3%")))
    max_per_window_usd: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("MAX_PER_WINDOW_USD", 20))
    max_unhedged_usd: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("MAX_UNHEDGED_USD", 10))
    max_adds: int = field(default_factory=lambda: _i("MAX_ADDS", 3))
    max_loss_per_window_usd: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("MAX_LOSS_PER_WINDOW_USD", 3))
    daily_max_loss_usd: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("DAILY_MAX_LOSS_USD", 30))
    fee_in_shares: bool = field(default_factory=lambda: _b("FEE_IN_SHARES", True))

    # --- тайминг окна (секунды от начала окна) ---
    window_sec: int = 300
    quoting_end_sec: int = field(default_factory=lambda: _i("QUOTING_END_SEC", 210))
    hedge_only_end_sec: int = field(default_factory=lambda: _i("HEDGE_ONLY_END_SEC", 240))
    prefetch_sec: int = field(default_factory=lambda: _i("PREFETCH_SEC", 30))
    resolve_timeout_sec: int = field(default_factory=lambda: _i("RESOLVE_TIMEOUT_SEC", 1800))
    loop_interval_sec: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("LOOP_INTERVAL_SEC", 0.25))

    # --- защиты ---
    fast_move_bps: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("FAST_MOVE_BPS", 10))
    fast_move_sec: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("FAST_MOVE_SEC", 10))
    fast_move_cooldown_sec: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("FAST_MOVE_COOLDOWN_SEC", 15))
    stale_sec: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("STALE_SEC", 15))
    price_stale_sec: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("PRICE_STALE_SEC", 10))
    reprice_min_ticks: int = field(default_factory=lambda: _i("REPRICE_MIN_TICKS", 2))  # >1 тика
    reprice_min_interval_sec: float = field(default_factory=lambda: _f("REPRICE_MIN_INTERVAL_SEC", 1.0))
    binance_fallback: bool = field(default_factory=lambda: _b("BINANCE_FALLBACK", True))

    # --- прочее ---
    db_path: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _s("DB_PATH", str(BASE_DIR / "data" / "polybot.sqlite")))
    log_dir: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _s("LOG_DIR", str(BASE_DIR / "logs")))
    log_level: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _s("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))
    report_empty_windows: bool = field(default_factory=lambda: _b("REPORT_EMPTY_WINDOWS", False))
    max_windows: int = field(default_factory=lambda: _i("MAX_WINDOWS", 0))  # 0 = бесконечно (для тестовых прогонов)

    # --- эндпоинты ---
    gamma_url: str = "https://gamma-api.polymarket.com"
    clob_ws_url: str = "wss://ws-subscriptions-clob.polymarket.com/ws/market"

"""Поиск 5-минутного рынка BTC Up/Down по slug через Gamma API.

Slug (проверено по Gamma): btc-updown-5m-<unix ts начала окна>, ts кратно 300.
Токены: clobTokenIds[i] соответствует outcomes[i] ("Up"/"Down").
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass

import aiohttp

from position import DOWN, UP

log = logging.getLogger("finder")

WINDOW = 300


def window_start(ts: float | None = None) -> int:
    ts = time.time() if ts is None else ts
    return int(ts) // WINDOW * WINDOW


def slug_for(start_ts: int) -> str:
    return f"btc-updown-5m-{start_ts}"


@dataclass
class MarketInfo:
    slug: str
    start_ts: int
    end_ts: int
    question: str
    condition_id: str
    token: dict            # {UP: token_id, DOWN: token_id}
    tick: float
    min_size: float
    fee_rate: float
    fee_exponent: float
    fees_enabled: bool
    accepting_orders: bool

    def side_of(self, token_id: str) -> str | None:
        for s, t in self.token.items():
            if t == token_id:
                return s
        return None


def _loads(v):
    return json.loads(v) if isinstance(v, str) else v


def parse_market(m: dict, start_ts: int) -> MarketInfo:
    outcomes = [o.strip().lower() for o in _loads(m["outcomes"])]
    tokens = _loads(m["clobTokenIds"])
    token = {UP: tokens[outcomes.index("up")], DOWN: tokens[outcomes.index("down")]}
    fs = m.get("feeSchedule") or {}
    return MarketInfo(
        slug=m["slug"], start_ts=start_ts, end_ts=start_ts + WINDOW,
        question=m.get("question", ""), condition_id=m.get("conditionId", ""),
        token=token,
        tick=float(m.get("orderPriceMinTickSize") or 0.01),
        min_size=float(m.get("orderMinSize") or 5),
        fee_rate=float(fs.get("rate", 0.07)) if m.get("feesEnabled", True) else 0.0,
        fee_exponent=float(fs.get("exponent", 1)),
        fees_enabled=bool(m.get("feesEnabled", True)),
        accepting_orders=bool(m.get("acceptingOrders", True)),
    )


class MarketFinder:
    def __init__(self, gamma_url: str):
        self.gamma = gamma_url.rstrip("/")
        self._session: aiohttp.ClientSession | None = None

    async def session(self) -> aiohttp.ClientSession:
        if self._session is None or self._session.closed:
            self._session = aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=10))
        return self._session

    async def close(self):
        if self._session and not self._session.closed:
            await self._session.close()

    async def _get_market_raw(self, slug: str, closed: bool | None = None) -> dict | None:
        params = {"slug": slug}
        if closed is not None:
            params["closed"] = "true" if closed else "false"
        s = await self.session()
        async with s.get(f"{self.gamma}/markets", params=params) as r:
            if r.status == 429:
                raise RuntimeError("Gamma rate limit 429")
            r.raise_for_status()
            data = await r.json()
        return data[0] if data else None

    async def find(self, start_ts: int, retries: int = 6) -> MarketInfo | None:
        slug = slug_for(start_ts)
        delay = 1.0
        for attempt in range(retries):
            try:
                m = await self._get_market_raw(slug)
                if m is None:
                    m = await self._get_market_raw(slug, closed=True)
                if m:
                    info = parse_market(m, start_ts)
                    log.info("market %s | Up=%s… Down=%s… tick=%s min=%s fee=%s^%s",
                             slug, info.token[UP][:10], info.token[DOWN][:10], info.tick,
                             info.min_size, info.fee_rate, info.fee_exponent)
                    return info
                log.warning("market %s not found yet (attempt %d)", slug, attempt + 1)
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                log.warning("gamma error for %s: %r", slug, e)
            await asyncio.sleep(delay)
            delay = min(delay * 2, 10)
        return None

    async def resolution(self, slug: str) -> str | None:
        """Вернёт UP/DOWN, если Polymarket уже зарезолвил рынок, иначе None."""
        m = await self._get_market_raw(slug, closed=True)
        if not m:
            m = await self._get_market_raw(slug)
        if not m:
            return None
        prices = [float(x) for x in _loads(m.get("outcomePrices") or "[]")]
        outcomes = [o.strip().lower() for o in _loads(m.get("outcomes") or "[]")]
        resolved = m.get("umaResolutionStatus") == "resolved" or m.get("closed")
        if not resolved or len(prices) != 2:
            return None
        if max(prices) < 0.999:
            return None
        win = outcomes[prices.index(max(prices))]
        return UP if win == "up" else DOWN

    fee_exponent: float
    fees_enabled: bool
    accepting_orders: bool

    def side_of(self, token_id: str) -> str | None:
        for s, t in self.token.items():
            if t == token_id:
                return s
        return None


def _loads(v):
    return json.loads(v) if isinstance(v, str) else v


def parse_market(m: dict, start_ts: int) -> MarketInfo:
    outcomes = [o.strip().lower() for o in _loads(m["outcomes"])]
    tokens = _loads(m["clobTokenIds"])
    token = {UP: tokens[outcomes.index("up")], DOWN: tokens[outcomes.index("down")]}
    fs = m.get("feeSchedule") or {}
    return MarketInfo(
        slug=m["slug"], start_ts=start_ts, end_ts=start_ts + WINDOW,
        question=m.get("question", ""), condition_id=m.get("conditionId", ""),
        token=token,
        tick=float(m.get("orderPriceMinTickSize") or 0.01),
        min_size=float(m.get("orderMinSize") or 5),
        fee_rate=float(fs.get("rate", 0.07)) if m.get("feesEnabled", True) else 0.0,
        fee_exponent=float(fs.get("exponent", 1)),
        fees_enabled=bool(m.get("feesEnabled", True)),
        accepting_orders=bool(m.get("acceptingOrders", True)),
    )


class MarketFinder:
    def __init__(self, gamma_url: str):
        self.gamma = gamma_url.rstrip("/")
        self._session: aiohttp.ClientSession | None = None

    async def session(self) -> aiohttp.ClientSession:
        if self._session is None or self._session.closed:
            self._session = aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=10))
        return self._session

    async def close(self):
        if self._session and not self._session.closed:
            await self._session.close()

    async def _get_market_raw(self, slug: str, closed: bool | None = None) -> dict | None:
        params = {"slug": slug}
        if closed is not None:
            params["closed"] = "true" if closed else "false"
        s = await self.session()
        async with s.get(f"{self.gamma}/markets", params=params) as r:
            if r.status == 429:
                raise RuntimeError("Gamma rate limit 429")
            r.raise_for_status()
            data = await r.json()
        return data[0] if data else None

    async def find(self, start_ts: int, retries: int = 6) -> MarketInfo | None:
        slug = slug_for(start_ts)
        delay = 1.0
        for attempt in range(retries):
            try:
                m = await self._get_market_raw(slug)
                if m is None:
                    m = await self._get_market_raw(slug, closed=True)
                if m:
                    info = parse_market(m, start_ts)
                    log.info("market %s | Up=%s… Down=%s… tick=%s min=%s fee=%s^%s",
                             slug, info.token[UP][:10], info.token[DOWN][:10], info.tick,
                             info.min_size, info.fee_rate, info.fee_exponent)
                    return info
                log.warning("market %s not found yet (attempt %d)", slug, attempt + 1)
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                log.warning("gamma error for %s: %r", slug, e)
            await asyncio.sleep(delay)
            delay = min(delay * 2, 10)
        return None

    async def resolution(self, slug: str) -> str | None:
        """Вернёт UP/DOWN, если Polymarket уже зарезолвил рынок, иначе None."""
        m = await self._get_market_raw(slug, closed=True)
        if not m:
            m = await self._get_market_raw(slug)
        if not m:
            return None
        prices = [float(x) for x in _loads(m.get("outcomePrices") or "[]")]
        outcomes = [o.strip().lower() for o in _loads(m.get("outcomes") or "[]")]
        resolved = m.get("umaResolutionStatus") == "resolved" or m.get("closed")
        if not resolved or len(prices) != 2:
            return None
        if max(prices) < 0.999:
            return None
        win = outcomes[prices.index(max(prices))]
        return UP if win == "up" else DOWN

"""Проверка связи: находит текущее окно, печатает стакан Up/Down и цену Chainlink.
Запуск: python check_feeds.py [секунд]"""
import asyncio
import logging
import sys
import time

from config import CFG
from feeds import MarketFeed, PriceFeed
from market_finder import MarketFinder, window_start
from position import DOWN, UP


async def main(duration: int):
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
    finder = MarketFinder(CFG.gamma_url)
    m = await finder.find(window_start())
    if not m:
        print("Рынок не найден")
        return
    print(f"Окно: {m.slug} | {m.question}")
    mf = MarketFeed(CFG.clob_ws_url)
    pf = PriceFeed(CFG.rtds_ws_url, CFG.binance_ws_url, CFG.price_stale_sec)
    counts = {}
    mf.add_listener(lambda et, a, msg: counts.__setitem__(et, counts.get(et, 0) + 1))
    await mf.subscribe([m.token[UP], m.token[DOWN]])
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(mf.run()), asyncio.create_task(pf.run())]
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < duration:
        await asyncio.sleep(3)
        parts = []
        for s in (UP, DOWN):

            asks, bids = b.sorted_asks()[:3], b.sorted_bids()[:3]
            parts.append(f"{s}: bid={b.best_bid} ask={b.best_ask} last={b.last_trade} "
                         f"age={mf.book_age(m.token[s]):.1f}s top3bids={bids} top3asks={asks}")
        cl = pf.hist["chainlink"][-1][1] if pf.hist["chainlink"] else None
        bn = pf.hist["binance"][-1][1] if pf.hist["binance"] else None
        mv, src = pf.move_bps(CFG.fast_move_sec)
        print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] chainlink={cl} binance={bn} move{int(CFG.fast_move_sec)}s="
              f"{mv if mv is None else round(mv, 2)}bps({src})")
        for p in parts:
            print("   ", p)
    print("Событий по типам:", counts)
    for t in tasks:
        t.cancel()
    await finder.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 20))

"""SQLite: окна, заявки, исполнения, PnL, флаги."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sqlite3
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS windows (
    slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    start_ts INTEGER, mode TEXT, status TEXT,
    qty_up REAL DEFAULT 0, qty_down REAL DEFAULT 0, spent REAL DEFAULT 0, fees REAL DEFAULT 0,
    avg_up REAL, avg_down REAL, n_fills INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    hedged INTEGER DEFAULT 0, worst_case REAL DEFAULT 0,
    force_used INTEGER DEFAULT 0, force_action TEXT, force_worst_before REAL, force_worst_after REAL,
    winner TEXT, pnl REAL, day TEXT, created_at REAL, resolved_at REAL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT, side TEXT, action TEXT, kind TEXT, purpose TEXT,
    price REAL, size REAL, status TEXT, created_at REAL, updated_at REAL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fills (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, order_id TEXT, slug TEXT, side TEXT, action TEXT,
    price REAL, shares REAL, net_shares REAL, cash REAL, fee_usd REAL, liquidity TEXT, ts REAL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kv (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT);
"""


def utc_day(ts: float | None = None) -> str:
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ts if ts is not None else time.time(), tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


class Storage:
    def __init__(self, path: str):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=False)
        self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.db.executescript(SCHEMA)
        self.db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")

    # ---------- kv ----------
    def get(self, k: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:
        r = self.db.execute("SELECT v FROM kv WHERE k=?", (k,)).fetchone()
        return r["v"] if r else default

    def set(self, k: str, v: str):
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO kv(k,v) VALUES(?,?) ON CONFLICT(k) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v", (k, v))

    # ---------- windows ----------
    def upsert_window(self, slug: str, **f):
        f.setdefault("created_at", time.time())
        cols = ", ".join(f.keys())
        qs = ", ".join("?" for _ in f)
        upd = ", ".join(f"{k}=excluded.{k}" for k in f if k != "created_at")
        self.db.execute(f"INSERT INTO windows(slug, {cols}) VALUES(?, {qs}) "
                        f"ON CONFLICT(slug) DO UPDATE SET {upd}", (slug, *f.values()))

    def update_window(self, slug: str, **f):
        sets = ", ".join(f"{k}=?" for k in f)
        self.db.execute(f"UPDATE windows SET {sets} WHERE slug=?", (*f.values(), slug))

    def window(self, slug: str):
        return self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM windows WHERE slug=?", (slug,)).fetchone()

    def unresolved_windows(self):
        return self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM windows WHERE status='HOLD' AND n_fills>0").fetchall()

    # ---------- orders/fills ----------
    def log_order(self, oid: str, slug: str, side: str, action: str, kind: str, purpose: str,
                  price: float, size: float, status: str):
        now = time.time()
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO orders VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET "
                        "status=excluded.status, updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
                        (oid, slug, side, action, kind, purpose, price, size, status, now, now))

    def order_status(self, oid: str, status: str):
        self.db.execute("UPDATE orders SET status=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?", (status, time.time(), oid))

    def log_fill(self, order_id: str, slug: str, fill):
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO fills(order_id, slug, side, action, price, shares, net_shares, cash, "
                        "fee_usd, liquidity, ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                        (order_id, slug, fill.side, fill.action, fill.price, fill.shares, fill.net_shares,
                         fill.cash, fill.fee_usd, fill.liquidity, time.time()))

    # ---------- статистика ----------
    def day_pnl(self, day: str | None = None) -> float:
        r = self.db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl),0) s FROM windows WHERE day=? AND status='RESOLVED'",
                            (day or utc_day(),)).fetchone()
        return float(r["s"])

    def pending_worst(self) -> float:
        """Худший исход по окнам, которые ещё ждут резолюции (для дневного стопа)."""
        r = self.db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(MIN(worst_case,0)),0) s FROM windows "
                            "WHERE status IN ('HOLD','ACTIVE') AND n_fills>0").fetchone()
        return float(r["s"])

    def stats(self, day: str | None = None) -> dict:
        where = "status='RESOLVED' AND n_fills>0" + (" AND day=?" if day else "")
        args = (day,) if day else ()
        rows = self.db.execute(f"SELECT * FROM windows WHERE {where}", args).fetchall()
        total = self.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM windows WHERE status='RESOLVED'" +
                                (" AND day=?" if day else ""), args).fetchone()["c"]
        n = len(rows)
        pnls = [r["pnl"] for r in rows]
        force = [r for r in rows if r["force_used"]]
        worst = min(rows, key=lambda r: r["pnl"]) if rows else None
        return {
            "windows_total": total,
            "windows_traded": n,
            "hedged_pct": (100.0 * sum(1 for r in rows if r["hedged"]) / n) if n else 0.0,
            "pnl_sum": sum(pnls),
            "pnl_avg": (sum(pnls) / n) if n else 0.0,
            "worst_slug": worst["slug"] if worst else None,
            "worst_pnl": worst["pnl"] if worst else 0.0,
            "force_count": len(force),
            "force_pnl_sum": sum(r["pnl"] for r in force),
            "force_cost_sum": sum((r["force_worst_after"] or 0) - (r["force_worst_before"] or 0) for r in force),
            "wins": sum(1 for p in pnls if p > 0),
        }

import os
import sqlite3
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS windows (
    slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    start_ts INTEGER, mode TEXT, status TEXT,
    qty_up REAL DEFAULT 0, qty_down REAL DEFAULT 0, spent REAL DEFAULT 0, fees REAL DEFAULT 0,
    avg_up REAL, avg_down REAL, n_fills INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    hedged INTEGER DEFAULT 0, worst_case REAL DEFAULT 0,
    force_used INTEGER DEFAULT 0, force_action TEXT, force_worst_before REAL, force_worst_after REAL,
    winner TEXT, pnl REAL, day TEXT, created_at REAL, resolved_at REAL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT, side TEXT, action TEXT, kind TEXT, purpose TEXT,
    price REAL, size REAL, status TEXT, created_at REAL, updated_at REAL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fills (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, order_id TEXT, slug TEXT, side TEXT, action TEXT,
    price REAL, shares REAL, net_shares REAL, cash REAL, fee_usd REAL, liquidity TEXT, ts REAL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kv (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT);
"""


def utc_day(ts: float | None = None) -> str:
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ts if ts is not None else time.time(), tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


class Storage:
    def __init__(self, path: str):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=False)
        self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.db.executescript(SCHEMA)
        self.db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")

    # ---------- kv ----------
    def get(self, k: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:
        r = self.db.execute("SELECT v FROM kv WHERE k=?", (k,)).fetchone()
        return r["v"] if r else default

    def set(self, k: str, v: str):
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO kv(k,v) VALUES(?,?) ON CONFLICT(k) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v", (k, v))

    # ---------- windows ----------
    def upsert_window(self, slug: str, **f):
        f.setdefault("created_at", time.time())
        cols = ", ".join(f.keys())
        qs = ", ".join("?" for _ in f)
        upd = ", ".join(f"{k}=excluded.{k}" for k in f if k != "created_at")
        self.db.execute(f"INSERT INTO windows(slug, {cols}) VALUES(?, {qs}) "
                        f"ON CONFLICT(slug) DO UPDATE SET {upd}", (slug, *f.values()))

    def update_window(self, slug: str, **f):
        sets = ", ".join(f"{k}=?" for k in f)
        self.db.execute(f"UPDATE windows SET {sets} WHERE slug=?", (*f.values(), slug))

    def window(self, slug: str):
        return self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM windows WHERE slug=?", (slug,)).fetchone()

    def unresolved_windows(self):
        return self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM windows WHERE status='HOLD' AND n_fills>0").fetchall()

    # ---------- orders/fills ----------
    def log_order(self, oid: str, slug: str, side: str, action: str, kind: str, purpose: str,
                  price: float, size: float, status: str):
        now = time.time()
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO orders VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET "
                        "status=excluded.status, updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
                        (oid, slug, side, action, kind, purpose, price, size, status, now, now))

    def order_status(self, oid: str, status: str):

    def log_fill(self, order_id: str, slug: str, fill):

                         fill.cash, fill.fee_usd, fill.liquidity, time.time()))

"""Решения: что котировать и как добирать. Никаких сетевых вызовов - только расчёт."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

from position import (EPS, SIDES, Fill, Position, floor_to_tick, other, taker_buy_fill,
                      taker_sell_fill, walk_book)

QUOTING = "QUOTING"
HEDGE_ONLY = "HEDGE_ONLY"


@dataclass
class Quote:
    side: str
    price: float
    size: float
    purpose: str      # entry / add / hedge
    note: str = ""


def round_up_shares(x: float) -> float:
    return math.ceil(x * 100 - 1e-6) / 100


def projected_hedge_cost(pos: Position, cfg, tick: float) -> float | None:
    """Сколько ещё придётся потратить, чтобы захеджировать позицию по макс. допустимой цене.
    None - захеджировать с MIN_PROFIT уже невозможно."""
    if pos.is_hedged(cfg.min_profit):
        return 0.0
    lead = pos.leading_side()
    if lead is None:
        return None
    lag = other(lead)
    d = round_up_shares(pos.deficit(lag))
    p = pos.max_hedge_price_maker(lag, d, cfg.min_profit, tick)
    return None if p is None else d * p


def desired_quotes(pos: Position, phase: str, books: dict, market, cfg,
                   paused: set, adds: dict, mode: str) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """Возвращает ({side: Quote|None}, {side: причина_если_None})."""
    out: dict = {s: None for s in SIDES}
    why: dict = {s: "" for s in SIDES}
    tick = market.tick
    hedged = pos.is_hedged(cfg.min_profit)
    for side in SIDES:
        if side in paused:
            why[side] = "paused(fast move)"
            continue
        book = books[side]
        if book.best_ask is None or book.best_bid is None:
            why[side] = "no book"
            continue
        max_post = round(book.best_ask - tick, 6)        # post-only: не пересекать ask
        deficit = pos.deficit(side)

        # 1) нога-хедж: отстающая сторона незахеджированной позиции
        if not pos.is_empty and not hedged and deficit > EPS:
            n = max(round_up_shares(deficit), market.min_size)
            pmax = pos.max_hedge_price_maker(side, n, cfg.min_profit, tick)
            if pmax is None:
                why[side] = f"hedge impossible for {n} sh"
                continue
            price = floor_to_tick(min(pmax, max_post), tick)
            if price < tick:
                why[side] = "hedge price < tick"
                continue
            out[side] = Quote(side, price, n, "hedge", f"pmax={pmax:.2f}")
            continue

        # 2) вход / усреднение - только в QUOTING и при нормальном режиме риска
        if phase != QUOTING or mode != "ok":
            why[side] = f"no new entries ({phase}/{mode})"
            continue
        if pos.qty[side] < EPS and pos.qty[other(side)] < EPS:
            purpose, price = "entry", cfg.start_bid
        else:
            if adds[side] >= cfg.max_adds:
                why[side] = f"MAX_ADDS {adds[side]}"
                continue
            avg = pos.avg_price(side)
            purpose = "add"
            price = cfg.start_bid if avg is None else min(cfg.start_bid, avg - cfg.add_step)
        price = floor_to_tick(min(price, max_post), tick)
        if price < tick:
            why[side] = "price < tick"
            continue
        size = max(cfg.quote_size, market.min_size)
        after = pos.what_if_maker_buy(side, size, price)
        if after.unhedged_risk() > cfg.max_unhedged_usd + EPS:
            why[side] = f"unhedged risk {after.unhedged_risk():.2f} > {cfg.max_unhedged_usd}"
            continue
        hc = projected_hedge_cost(after, cfg, tick)
        if hc is None:
            why[side] = "no profitable hedge after add"
            continue
        if after.spent + hc > cfg.max_per_window_usd + EPS:
            why[side] = f"window budget {after.spent + hc:.2f} > {cfg.max_per_window_usd}"
            continue
        out[side] = Quote(side, price, size, purpose)
    return out, why


# ---------------- FORCE ----------------
@dataclass
class ForcePlan:
    action: str            # buy / sell / none
    side: str | None
    shares: float
    limit_price: float | None
    worst_before: float
    worst_after: float
    fills: list
    note: str


def _simulate(pos: Position, fills: list[Fill]) -> Position:
    c = pos.clone()
    for f in fills:
        c.apply(f)
    return c


def plan_buy_lagging(pos: Position, lag: str, asks: list, market, cfg) -> tuple[list[Fill], float | None]:
    """FAK-покупка отстающей ноги до выравнивания qty (с поправкой на комиссию шейрами)."""
    d = pos.deficit(lag)
    gross = d
    for _ in range(4):            # увеличиваем объём, чтобы нетто после комиссии покрыло дефицит
        levels = walk_book(asks, gross)
        fills = [taker_buy_fill(lag, sh, pr, market.fee_rate, market.fee_exponent, cfg.fee_in_shares)
                 for pr, sh in levels]
        net = sum(f.net_shares for f in fills)
        if net >= d - 1e-6 or not levels or sum(s for _, s in levels) < gross - 1e-6:
            break
        gross = round_up_shares(gross * d / max(net, EPS))
    limit = max((f.price for f in fills), default=None)
    return fills, limit


def plan_sell_excess(pos: Position, lead: str, bids: list, market) -> tuple[list[Fill], float | None]:
    e = pos.qty[lead] - pos.qty[other(lead)]
    e = math.floor(e * 100 + 1e-6) / 100
    levels = walk_book(bids, e, is_buy=False)
    fills = [taker_sell_fill(lead, sh, pr, market.fee_rate, market.fee_exponent) for pr, sh in levels]
    limit = min((f.price for f in fills), default=None)
    return fills, limit


def force_plan(pos: Position, books: dict, market, cfg) -> ForcePlan:
    before = pos.worst_case
    if pos.is_empty or pos.is_hedged(cfg.min_profit):
        return ForcePlan("none", None, 0, None, before, before, [], "hedged or empty")
    lead = pos.leading_side()
    if lead is None:
        return ForcePlan("none", None, 0, None, before, before, [], "qty equal, nothing to fix")
    lag = other(lead)

    a_fills, a_limit = plan_buy_lagging(pos, lag, books[lag].sorted_asks(), market, cfg)
    a_after = _simulate(pos, a_fills).worst_case if a_fills else None
    a_ok = a_after is not None and a_after >= -cfg.max_loss_per_window_usd - EPS

    b_fills, b_limit = plan_sell_excess(pos, lead, books[lead].sorted_bids(), market)
    b_after = _simulate(pos, b_fills).worst_case if b_fills else None

    cands = []
    if a_ok:
        cands.append(ForcePlan("buy", lag, sum(f.shares for f in a_fills), a_limit, before, a_after, a_fills,
                               f"A: buy {lag}"))
    if b_after is not None:
        cands.append(ForcePlan("sell", lead, sum(f.shares for f in b_fills), b_limit, before, b_after, b_fills,
                               f"B: sell {lead}"))
    note = (f"A(buy {lag})={'n/a' if a_after is None else f'{a_after:.3f}'}{'' if a_ok else ' rejected'} "
            f"B(sell {lead})={'n/a' if b_after is None else f'{b_after:.3f}'}")
    if not cands:
        return ForcePlan("none", None, 0, None, before, before, [], "no liquidity: " + note)
    best = max(cands, key=lambda c: c.worst_after)
    best.note = note + f" -> {best.action}"
    return best

                   paused: set, adds: dict, mode: str) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """Возвращает ({side: Quote|None}, {side: причина_если_None})."""
    out: dict = {s: None for s in SIDES}
    why: dict = {s: "" for s in SIDES}
    tick = market.tick
    hedged = pos.is_hedged(cfg.min_profit)
    for side in SIDES:
        if side in paused:
            why[side] = "paused(fast move)"
            continue

        if book.best_ask is None or book.best_bid is None:

            if pmax is None:
                why[side] = f"hedge impossible for {n} sh"
                continue
            price = floor_to_tick(min(pmax, max_post), tick)
            if price < tick:
                why[side] = "hedge price < tick"
                continue
            out[side] = Quote(side, price, n, "hedge", f"pmax={pmax:.2f}")
            continue

        # 2) вход / усреднение - только в QUOTING и при нормальном режиме риска
        if phase != QUOTING or mode != "ok":
            why[side] = f"no new entries ({phase}/{mode})"
            continue

            purpose, price = "entry", cfg.start_bid
        else:
            if adds[side] >= cfg.max_adds:
                why[side] = f"MAX_ADDS {adds[side]}"
                continue
            avg = pos.avg_price(side)
            purpose = "add"
            price = cfg.start_bid if avg is None else min(cfg.start_bid, avg - cfg.add_step)
        price = floor_to_tick(min(price, max_post), tick)
        if price < tick:

            continue

    """FAK-покупка отстающей ноги до выравнивания qty (с поправкой на комиссию шейрами)."""

    return fills, limit

    e = pos.qty[lead] - pos.qty[other(lead)]

    a_ok = a_after is not None and a_after >= -cfg.max_loss_per_window_usd - EPS

    cands = []

    note = (f"A(buy {lag})={'n/a' if a_after is None else f'{a_after:.3f}'}{'' if a_ok else ' rejected'} "

    if not cands:
        return ForcePlan("none", None, 0, None, before, before, [], "no liquidity: " + note)
    best = max(cands, key=lambda c: c.worst_after)
    best.note = note + f" -> {best.action}"
    return best

"""Исполнение ордеров. PaperExecutor и LiveExecutor с одним интерфейсом.

PAPER (консервативно):
  * BUY-лимитка по цене P исполняется, только если прошла сделка СТРОГО ниже P
    (объём исполнения <= объёма той сделки), либо best_ask опустился НИЖЕ P
    (объём <= суммы асков ниже P). Касание цены не считается - мы в конце очереди.
  * post-only: лимитка, которая пересекла бы ask (P >= best_ask), отклоняется.
  * Маркет FAK проходит по уровням стакана, с taker-комиссией.

LIVE заблокирован: объект нельзя создать без LIVE_TRADING=true в .env.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import itertools
import logging
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Callable

from position import EPS, Fill, maker_buy_fill, taker_buy_fill, taker_sell_fill, walk_book

log = logging.getLogger("exec")


@dataclass
class Order:
    id: str
    slug: str
    token: str
    side: str            # UP / DOWN
    action: str          # BUY / SELL
    price: float
    size: float
    purpose: str
    filled: float = 0.0
    status: str = "live"          # live / filled / canceled / rejected
    created: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
    counted: bool = False         # засчитан ли уже в MAX_ADDS

    @property
    def remaining(self) -> float:
        return max(0.0, self.size - self.filled)


FillCallback = Callable[[Order, Fill], None]


class BaseExecutor:
    mode = "base"

    def __init__(self, storage):
        self.storage = storage
        self.callbacks: dict[str, FillCallback] = {}   # slug -> callback

    def register(self, slug: str, cb: FillCallback):
        self.callbacks[slug] = cb

    def unregister(self, slug: str):
        self.callbacks.pop(slug, None)

    def _deliver(self, order: Order, fill: Fill):
        self.storage.log_fill(order.id, order.slug, fill)
        cb = self.callbacks.get(order.slug)
        if cb:
            cb(order, fill)

    async def place_limit(self, market, side: str, price: float, size: float, purpose: str) -> Order | None:
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def cancel(self, order: Order) -> None:
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def cancel_all(self) -> None:
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def market_buy(self, market, side: str, shares: float, max_price: float, purpose: str) -> list[Fill]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def market_sell(self, market, side: str, shares: float, min_price: float, purpose: str) -> list[Fill]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class PaperExecutor(BaseExecutor):
    mode = "paper"

    def __init__(self, storage, feed, fee_in_shares: bool = True):
        super().__init__(storage)
        self.feed = feed
        self.fee_in_shares = fee_in_shares
        self.open: dict[str, Order] = {}
        self._ids = itertools.count(1)
        feed.add_listener(self._on_market_event)

    def _new_id(self) -> str:
        return f"paper-{int(time.time())}-{next(self._ids)}"

    async def place_limit(self, market, side, price, size, purpose):
        token = market.token[side]
        book = self.feed.book(token)
        oid = self._new_id()
        if book.best_ask is not None and price >= book.best_ask - EPS:
            log.info("[paper] post-only REJECT %s %s %.2f x %.2f (ask %.2f)", purpose, side, price, size, book.best_ask)
            self.storage.log_order(oid, market.slug, side, "BUY", "GTC-postonly", purpose, price, size, "rejected")
            return None
        o = Order(oid, market.slug, token, side, "BUY", price, size, purpose)
        self.open[oid] = o
        self.storage.log_order(oid, market.slug, side, "BUY", "GTC-postonly", purpose, price, size, "live")
        log.info("[paper] PLACE %s %s BUY %.2f x %.2f (bid %s ask %s)", purpose, side, price, size,
                 book.best_bid, book.best_ask)
        return o

    async def cancel(self, order):
        if order.id in self.open:
            self.open.pop(order.id)
            order.status = "canceled" if order.filled < EPS else "partial-canceled"
            self.storage.order_status(order.id, order.status)
            log.info("[paper] CANCEL %s %s %.2f (filled %.2f/%.2f)", order.purpose, order.side, order.price,
                     order.filled, order.size)

    async def cancel_all(self):
        for o in list(self.open.values()):
            await self.cancel(o)

    def _fill(self, o: Order, shares: float, reason: str):
        shares = min(shares, o.remaining)
        shares = int(shares * 100 + 1e-6) / 100.0
        if shares < 0.01:
            return
        o.filled += shares
        f = maker_buy_fill(o.side, shares, o.price)
        if o.remaining < 0.01:
            o.status = "filled"
            self.open.pop(o.id, None)
        self.storage.order_status(o.id, o.status)
        log.info("[paper] FILL %s %s BUY %.2f x %.2f (%s) -> %.2f/%.2f", o.purpose, o.side, o.price, shares,
                 reason, o.filled, o.size)
        self._deliver(o, f)

    def _on_market_event(self, et: str, asset: str, msg: dict):
        if not self.open:
            return
        orders = [o for o in self.open.values() if o.token == asset]
        if not orders:
            return
        if et == "last_trade_price":
            px, sz = float(msg["price"]), float(msg.get("size") or 0)
            for o in orders:
                if px < o.price - EPS and sz > 0:
                    take = min(sz, o.remaining)
                    sz -= take
                    self._fill(o, take, f"trade {px:.3f}<{o.price:.2f}")
        elif et in ("book", "price_change", "best_bid_ask"):
            book = self.feed.book(asset)
            if book.best_ask is None:
                return
            for o in orders:
                if book.best_ask < o.price - EPS:
                    avail = sum(s for p, s in book.asks.items() if p < o.price - EPS and s > 0)
                    if avail <= 0:          # top-of-book без глубины (best_bid_ask) - считаем 1 уровень неизвестным
                        continue
                    self._fill(o, avail, f"ask {book.best_ask:.3f}<{o.price:.2f}")

    async def market_buy(self, market, side, shares, max_price, purpose):
        book = self.feed.book(market.token[side])
        levels = walk_book(book.sorted_asks(), shares, limit_price=max_price, is_buy=True)
        oid = self._new_id()
        o = Order(oid, market.slug, market.token[side], side, "BUY", max_price, shares, purpose)
        fills = []
        for px, sh in levels:
            f = taker_buy_fill(side, sh, px, market.fee_rate, market.fee_exponent, self.fee_in_shares)
            fills.append(f)
            o.filled += sh
        o.status = "filled" if o.remaining < 0.01 else ("partial" if fills else "killed")
        self.storage.log_order(oid, market.slug, side, "BUY", "FAK", purpose, max_price, shares, o.status)
        log.info("[paper] FAK BUY %s %.2f sh max %.2f -> %s", side, shares, max_price,
                 [(round(f.price, 3), round(f.shares, 2), round(f.net_shares, 3)) for f in fills])
        for f in fills:
            self._deliver(o, f)
        return fills

    async def market_sell(self, market, side, shares, min_price, purpose):
        book = self.feed.book(market.token[side])
        levels = walk_book(book.sorted_bids(), shares, limit_price=min_price, is_buy=False)
        oid = self._new_id()
        o = Order(oid, market.slug, market.token[side], side, "SELL", min_price, shares, purpose)
        fills = []
        for px, sh in levels:
            f = taker_sell_fill(side, sh, px, market.fee_rate, market.fee_exponent)
            fills.append(f)
            o.filled += sh
        o.status = "filled" if o.remaining < 0.01 else ("partial" if fills else "killed")
        self.storage.log_order(oid, market.slug, side, "SELL", "FAK", purpose, min_price, shares, o.status)
        log.info("[paper] FAK SELL %s %.2f sh min %.2f -> %s", side, shares, min_price,
                 [(round(f.price, 3), round(f.shares, 2)) for f in fills])
        for f in fills:
            self._deliver(o, f)
        return fills


class LiveTradingDisabled(RuntimeError):
    pass


class LiveExecutor(BaseExecutor):
    """Реальные ордера через официальный unified SDK `polymarket-client` (pip install polymarket-client).

    ВНИМАНИЕ: заблокирован флагом LIVE_TRADING и НЕ проверялся на реальных деньгах.
    Перед включением нужен отдельный прогон с минимальными суммами.
    """
    mode = "live"

    def __init__(self, storage, cfg):
        if not cfg.live_trading:
            raise LiveTradingDisabled("LIVE_TRADING=false - реальные ордера заблокированы")
        if not cfg.private_key:
            raise LiveTradingDisabled("POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY не задан в .env")
        super().__init__(storage)
        self.cfg = cfg

class Order:
    id: str
    slug: str
    token: str
    side: str            # UP / DOWN
    action: str          # BUY / SELL
    price: float
    size: float
    purpose: str

    created: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)

        self.storage = storage

    def register(self, slug: str, cb: FillCallback):
        self.callbacks[slug] = cb

    def unregister(self, slug: str):
        self.callbacks.pop(slug, None)
